[!cgo] skip
[short] skip '-a rebuilds the runtime'

go run .
stderr '^1 10$'

# The nested header is not a direct package input. Force a rebuild
# so cgo generation and C compilation both use the updated header.
cp changed.txt include/config.h
go run -a -x .
stderr '^2 20$'
stderr ' -c .*get\.c'

# The rebuilt outputs should be reusable by an ordinary invocation.
go run -x .
stderr '^2 20$'
! stderr ' -importpath example.com/cgorebuild '
! stderr ' -c .*get\.c'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgorebuild

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

// #include "api.h"
import "C"

func main() { println(C.V, C.get()) }
-- api.h --
#include "include/config.h"
int get(void);
-- include/config.h --
#define V 1
-- changed.txt --
#define V 2
-- get.c --
#include "api.h"
int get(void) { return V * 10; }
